judul: Longing for a Life That Feels Alive
isi:
I’ve been feeling empty for a long time. On the surface, my life looks normal. I can still sleep, I can still get through my days, but inside there’s a constant sense of emptiness I can’t really explain. It feels like I’m missing someone who never actually existed. Not a real person, but a presence that could make my life feel warm, meaningful, and alive. I want someone who makes life feel worth waking up to, but that person has never been there.

Over time, that emptiness turned into a quiet, constant exhaustion. I lost interest in things, and honestly, I don’t even remember what I used to enjoy anymore. Even when I’m with friends, the emptiness doesn’t go away. I’m there physically, but emotionally I feel distant. I keep moving forward, but it feels like I’m walking without direction. Some days I don’t know whether I believe in myself or not, and on days like today, I feel completely powerless.

One of the hardest parts is that I don’t know how to fully express what I feel. There’s so much inside me, but it stays unspoken. I hold things in, not because I want to, but because opening up feels confusing and unsafe. Because of that, I’ve never truly been close to anyone. I’ve never fully shown who I am or shared my feelings in a way that feels real and honest.

I often think about an ideal world, even though I can’t clearly picture it. It’s not a world without pain. There’s still suffering, anxiety, and struggle. But everything feels balanced. There’s meaning in the pain, happiness that feels real, and hope that makes it all bearable. What I’m living in now feels like the opposite, constant suffering with no balance, no pause, and no sense of hope.

I want to become the fullest version of myself, a stronger and more complete version of who I am. Not because I want a perfect life, but because I’m tired of feeling held back and alone. I want someone to walk beside me, not to fix my problems, but to make life feel worth living. And maybe the most painful part is that this desire feels completely human, yet it’s something I’ve never truly experienced.

Looking back at my younger days, a warmth rises in my chest with every memory. Life was not always easy. There were times I felt different or left out, but those moments left the most vivid marks. I learned to hide my pain and still find small sparks of light in the dark.

Simple things felt like treasures. Laughing with friends, sharing snacks, waiting for the bell to ring. Back then, I did not realize these ordinary days would one day feel precious. I lived lightly without worrying too much about the future.

Now everything feels different. The world is the same, but I see it with new eyes. Steps that once felt easy now carry weight, and the future seems daunting. Yet I believe there is still beauty to be found.

Perhaps one day I will look back at today and smile, realizing that every memory and every feeling shaped who I am now.

You know, I’m 20 now, and life just feels... less colorful. I know some people say this is the best time of their lives, especially if they had a dark past. But for me, I’m starting to lose interest in the things I used to enjoy. I don’t get excited about stuff like I did when I was a kid...

Maybe it’s just part of growing up...

I don’t know, man. I’m scared of the future. MY DUMB FUCKING BRAIN STILL HOPES I’ll randomly meet a girl who’ll somehow save me, bring color back into my life, make me happy. Someone I can protect too and we’d just get through life together.

Sometimes, when we feel really sad, we might think we’re depressed. But remember, only a professional can truly diagnose depression. If you're struggling, please seek help. Talk to your parents, your friends, or anyone you trust. You're not alone, and you don’t have to face it all by yourself.

Please, don’t turn to things like porn or harmful distractions, it won’t make the pain go away; it only makes things worse.

Hold on to what truly matters to you. Even if you feel like no one cares, even if you think God has forgotten you, He hasn’t. He’s still there.

You are not hopeless. You are worth helping.
